task.description:
Validate the CODE-DESIGNER design at src/design/service-task-test-capture-server.md, which fixes the flaky TC-EXT-01-U08a test (GH #528 / ISS-0207): CaptureServer hardcoded port 18181 + a cross-thread data race reading captured headers before the server thread finished writing them. Confirm the design covers both root causes and contains no implementation code.

RE-CHECK: CODE-DESIGNER has reworked the design per your BLOCKER/MINOR findings (rework 1/3) — std.Thread.ResetEvent replaced with std.Io.Event throughout, port accessor corrected to server.socket.address / listener.socket.address. Re-validate from scratch, including re-checking the std.Io.Event API against lib/std/Io.zig yourself.
acceptance_criteria: Design covers ephemeral port binding (port 0) + dynamic url_template construction, replacing the hardcoded 18181
Design covers a happens-before synchronisation primitive between the CaptureServer thread and the test assertions, replacing defer-at-scope-exit
No implementation code (compilable Zig) present in the design artefact
Design is complete enough for BACKEND-DEV to implement without further clarification

result.summary: Re-validated src/design/service-task-test-capture-server.md after rework 1/3. Verified std.Io.Event's actual API against lib/std/Io.zig L1766-1870 in the vendored zig 0.16.0 toolchain: enum(u32){unset,waiting,is_set}; wait(event: *Event, io: Io) Cancelable!void; waitUncancelable(event, io) void; waitTimeout(event, io, timeout) WaitTimeoutError!void; set(e, io) void. All match the design's descriptions exactly, including the Cancelable!void/try requirement on wait() and the mandatory io argument on every call. Verified std.Io.net.Server (lib/std/Io/net.zig L1402) is exactly {socket: Socket, options: AcceptOptions} with no listen_address field or getLocalAddress() accessor, and that Socket.address: IpAddress (L1055) carries the doc comment 'Contains the resolved ephemeral port number if requested' -- confirming listener.socket.address is a real, correct port-readback path (IpAddress.getPort() at L149 is the accessor). No implementation code or SQL/DDL present in the design (no code fences). tools/lint_design_artefact.py exits 0, no BLOCKER/MAJOR. All four acceptance criteria confirmed covered: ephemeral port binding + dynamic url_template, two distinct std.Io.Event happens-before primitives (listening, headers_captured) replacing defer-at-scope-exit, no implementation code, design implementable by BACKEND-DEV without further clarification.
